tagline: Canadian exploration and development company focused on gold and oil & gas assets
hero_kpi_rationale: Exploration-stage company with no pre-revenue phase and no significant operational activities. No relevant financial KPIs available in the documents. Operational status and cash position are key indicators for an exploration company.

kpis.name: Outstanding Shares
kpis.explanation: Total number of common shares outstanding as of the reporting date.
kpis.description: Total shares outstanding increased from prior year, indicating no material dilution or issuance in the period.

kpis.name: US Resident Shareholding
kpis.explanation: Percentage of shares held by US residents as of the reporting date.
kpis.description: US resident shareholders represent a minor portion of the cap table with 522 registered US shareholders.
kpis.signal: 48,759,720 shares held by US residents (5.66% of total) as of June 30, 2025

kpis.name: Key Management Compensation
kpis.explanation: Total compensation paid to key management personnel during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Compensation has remained flat at $48,000 for the past three years (2024, 2023, 2022), indicating minimal executive engagement.
kpis.signal: Key management compensation totaled $48,000 for year ended December 31, 2024

kpis.name: PXP Loan Balance
kpis.explanation: Outstanding balance of the PXP loan including accrued interest.
kpis.description: Outstanding PXP loan increased 32% year-over-year, with accrued interest of $105,431. Loan includes Libor plus 3.5% and is due on earliest of August 31, 2025, equity issuance, sale of FEL shares, or third party borrowing.
kpis.signal: PXP Loan balance of $895,637 as of December 31, 2024 (vs $678,155 in 2023)

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.explanation: Total interest expense for the fiscal year related to outstanding debt.
kpis.description: Interest expense nearly doubled from $32,593 in 2023, driven by increased PXP loan balances and accrued interest. Reflects company's reliance on related-party financing.
kpis.signal: Total interest expense of $62,196 for year ended December 31, 2024

kpis.name: Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from core business operations.
kpis.description: Company is in exploration phase with no material revenue generation. Future revenue and profitability dependent on commodity prices (gold, oil, gas).
kpis.signal: Company currently has no significant operating revenue

risks.title: Volatility of oil and natural gas prices
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the outset of Item 1A as a key factor affecting invested companies. Direct language (will be important). Structural recurring risk for the E&P sector. High weight: total dependence of success on profitable discoveries.

risks.title: Uncertainties regarding proved reserves and production timing
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed as major risk in Item 1A. Language of uncertainty (uncertainties in estimates). Direct impact on investment valuation and financial planning. Critical for an E&P investment company.

risks.title: Limited ability to commercialize reserves due to transportation infrastructure constraints
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk mentioned: potential constraints on the ability to market reserves due to limited transportation space. Moderate but concrete language. Affects realization of indirect investments.

risks.title: Operating hazards and risks inherent to oil and natural gas exploration and production
risks.score_rationale: Enumerated as operating hazards attendant to the oil and natural gas business. Direct language. Covers drilling, accidents, operational shutdowns. High potential impact on invested assets and cash flows.

risks.title: Dependence on invested companies' ability to acquire new reserves
risks.score_rationale: Key risk: ability of companies we invest in to find and acquire additional reserves. Language of critical importance. Without reserve replacement, assets decline. Directly linked to FEC's investment model.

risks.title: Geopolitical and regulatory risks, including Philippines-China territorial dispute
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned: territorial dispute between the Republic of Philippines and the People's Republic of China. Concrete language. Affects regional operations. Risk of energy regulation and foreign exchange restrictions.

risks.title: Environmental risks and adverse regulatory decisions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned twice: environmental risks and adverse regulatory or legal decisions under environmental laws. Moderate but repeated language. Increasing impact of environmental regulation on E&P operations.

risks.title: Dilution of control and inability to fund capital calls in FEL
risks.score_rationale: Specific and repeated risk: no guarantee that we can provide necessary funds and our interest in FEL may be diluted. Language of high uncertainty. Direct impact on 6.8% stake in FEL. Critical dependence on PXP.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the filing.
